jikan.title: Toaru Kagaku no Railgun: Misaka-san wa Ima Chuumoku no Mato desu kara
jikan.title_english: A Certain Scientific Railgun OVA: Since Misaka-san is the Center of Attention Right Now...
jikan.synopsis: Continuing after the Level Upper incident, another phenomenon torments Misaka. A phenomenon called "Someone's Watching," its effect feels like the electricity in one's body flow backwards. With the help of her friends, Misaka fights against the unknown enemy.
